meta.title: An unknown round sent as "TradeRequest" crashes every chats request
gaps: The plan checks that the request does not return a server error, but does not assert HTTP 422 or error code 533.

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: The buyer sends the chats request, the request the case itself writes.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
